title: 第3章 要上学了
content_zh:
几天之后，霍家彻底确定，霍海的确失去了一部分记忆，而且还是很大一部分。好在自己家里的人，他还记得，其他人。忘了就忘了，没什么关系，反正霍海年龄又不大。

身为霍家大少爷，也是唯一的少爷，别说他失忆了，就是疯了，也照样是霍家将来的掌权人物。这一天，霍开来到霍海的面前，一脸严肃的说道：“小海，你失忆的事情我们无能为力，但是一些常识，你不能不知道，所以我们决定送你去学习。”

学习？这是怎么回事，霍海头上全是问号。他知道，这种时候，最好是不要问的太多。

“很好，既然你不反对，那么就这样了，从今天开始，你就和其他家族子弟一起去学堂，学习一些基础和常识。其他人，可以等到以后再说。”

说完，霍开便离开了。霍海无奈的摇了摇头：“哎，这个世界到底是什么样的我都还不清楚，居然让我去上学。天啊，好不容易毕业了，怎么换了一个世界还要上学。难道就不能多修炼一下灵诀吗。”比起血气，霍海更加喜欢的是修炼。

以前不修炼不知道，以为一个人闷闷的坐在这里不动弹，好像白痴一样，要有很强的毅力的能坚持下来。可是修炼了之后，霍海就不这么想了。

吸收灵气进入身体，不断淬炼自身，能够感觉到自己时刻都在变强，身体都在升华。而且这种美妙的感觉，让人欲罢不能，简直比做那种事情还要舒服。

这下，霍海算是知道了，为什么一些高手，能够坐在那里修炼整整几年甚至几十年不动弹，原来修炼是这么舒服的事情。不但能让自己舒服，而且还能让自己的实力变强。有了实力，就有了地位，就什么都有了，有机会修炼，谁会放着不去呢。

可是父亲决定了，那么就只能这样了。“算了，看看那个课堂到底学的是什么，说不定能够加深对整个世界的了解。”霍海摇了摇头，再次开始修炼。

也不知道多长时间，才能进入灵血境界，看来要有时间浪费了。修炼到灵体就花费了好几年，现在要修炼到灵血，再怎么勤奋，也要好几个月的时间吧。

时间，就在霍海一夜修炼当中过去了。第二天一大早，丫鬟便将霍海叫醒。“少爷，少爷，快醒醒，你待会还要去学堂呢。”说道学堂，两个丫鬟的眼神有些古怪。

“是啊，还要去学堂。”霍海自言自语，昨天晚上很晚才睡。不过因为修炼的关系，霍海的精神却很好，他也没有看到两个丫鬟的表情。在丫鬟服侍之下，霍海穿好衣服，吃晚饭，然后便带着书童朝学堂走去。为什么要有书童，因为他还带着很多书呢。

“少爷的生活真是不错，这样的生活，以前在地球上，可没几个人有资格享受吧。不知道待会会学什么东西呢，会不会和修炼灵诀有关系呢。”

霍海脑袋里面，忽然回想起当初看到很多关于魔法学堂之类的小说动漫，要是这样就太好了。记忆不全，刚刚修炼的霍海，有很多不明白的问题，都急于搞清楚。

几分钟之后，霍海便在书童的带领之下，来到了学堂外面。说起来在，这个学堂还是霍家自己的学堂在，针对的人也是霍家嫡系和庶出，甚至是一些旁门亲戚的孩子。而那些下人们的孩子，就只能当书童，他们是没有资格进入学堂里面的。

霍海来到这里之后，发现这里已经有不少书童在了。他们都聚集在门口，或者趴在窗台上，等待着导师的讲课。身为下人，他们只有这样旁听的资格了。

看到这种情况，霍海不由的心中产生了一丝悲悯。“哎，还真是可怜啊，如果是地球，就算再穷，起码还能有一个小学读。”在灵界大陆，有资格享受教育的，毕竟只是少数人。

忽然，霍海狠狠的摇晃了一下脑袋：“我怎么会有这样的想法，我不是要当一个坏人吗。坏人见到这种情况应该怎么样呢，无动于衷？不对，不是这样。对了，应该上前讽刺，气压才对。”霍海回想了老半天，终于想起了坏人应该怎么做。

可是正当霍海准备行动的时候，却看到这些书童渴望和崇拜的眼神，原本打算说出口的话，顿时吞回了肚子里面。霍海终究不是一个天xing败坏的人，不能下手。

“算了，今天就放过你们，改天有就会再来。”霍海一边嘀咕着，放弃了所谓的坏人做法，进入学堂里面。霍海这一进去，里面的学生立刻将目光放在了霍海的身上，霍海感到一阵头皮发麻。接着，就不是头皮发麻了，而是一脸郁闷和震惊。

“谁，谁能告诉我，这到底是怎么回事，难道我要和这些小孩子一起学习吗。”霍海终于知道，那天父亲的眼神为什么这么古怪，还学习什么常识。

该死的，这哪里是在学习常识，这简直就是学前启蒙吗。看着这些小眼睛，他们的主人小的只有三岁，大的也不超过六岁。自己这个身体，好歹也有十四五岁了，在这股世界当中，已将算是成年了。难道要和这些还没有长大的小孩子一起学习不成。

“哎，那个就是新来的吗，他不是宗家的少爷吗，怎么会来这里。”小孩子的嘴是闲不住的。或许大人不会随便议论，可是小孩子，哪里会有这种想法。

“是啊是啊，我也听说了。好像霍海少爷因为什么原因受伤失忆了，就连我们要学的东西也要重新学习。”旁边，一个长相可爱的小女孩，一脸得意的说道。

哎哎，我说你吧，你长得可爱，可是你的嘴巴怎么这么可恶，什么叫受伤失忆，什么叫你们学的东西也要重新学习。你们这是在我面前秀你们的优越感吗。霍海心中都快要骂娘了。他感觉在这里，简直一刻都快要呆不下去了。

不过马上，他就见识到更可恶的了。一个可爱的小男孩，看着霍海，眼中满是同情。“啊，原来大少爷这么可怜啊，浪费了这么多年的时间。”

“是啊是啊，真可怜。”这一句话，立刻引起了小孩子们的共鸣。小孩子恐怕是这个世界上最有同情心的生物了。所有的目光，都变成了可怜当中带有同情。

霍海感觉自己快要疯了：“混蛋啊，我不需要你们来可怜。不，不对，我根本用不着你们来可怜。不对，这话也不对。”霍海彻底纠结了。这些小孩子是打也不是，骂也不成。虽然励志要做一个坏蛋，可坏蛋也是有底线的，小孩子怎么能随便欺负。

想到这里，霍海顿时感觉自己快要呆不下去了。于是乎转身就往外面走。可是刚刚来到门口，就被两个侍卫给拦住了。这两个人，堵在门口，不让霍海出去。

“少爷，老爷吩咐了，您在讲课完结之前，不能离开这个地方。您可不要让我们难做啊。为了少爷您能够早日将失去的记忆找回来，您就委屈一下吧。”两个护卫说的可怜兮兮的，却没有半点让开的意思。这两个护卫的修为，可是比霍海更高。

“你们真的不让开。”霍海脸色变了，冲撞了几下，都没能出去。

两个护卫对视一眼，脸色更苦了，这两个就是先前和霍海一起出去抓捕灵兽的两个人，如今又被派来看着霍海：“少爷，您就别为难我们两个了。要是您今天出去了，老爷非要打断我们的腿不可。”霍海少爷是很好说话的，换了别人他们可不敢这样说。

“你们，你们真的不让开……好吧，那我让开。”确定自己出不去的霍海，顿时泄气，重新回到了学堂当中。此时导师还没有来到学堂。

学堂里面的小孩子，有的凑在一起说话，有些正在翻看着手中特殊树叶做成的书籍，温习这昨天学到的东西。霍海可没心情和这些小孩子混到一起。前世自己已经二十多岁了。这一世这个身体，也有十四五岁的样子，加上一定的记忆。

算起来，自己的心里年龄恐怕已经可以做到三十多岁了，怎么能拉下脸来和这些小家伙们做到一起，一口气没有地方发泄，霍海就开始扫视着周围。

忽然，霍海眼睛当中灵光一闪：“对了，我不是要从小坏事开始做起吗，那么就先试试手吧。反正这股世界，应该没有这些手段吧。”霍海的脑袋里面，忽然回想起大量学生整蛊老师的画面。这些画面，很多都是从电视上面雪来的。也有从电脑书籍上面学到的。

感谢电视，感谢那些不良人士，交给了我们这么多整蛊老师的方法。要是不在这个世界上重现出来，岂不是愧对我穿越众的身份吗。霍海感觉自己全身都快要燃烧起来了。

想到就做，霍海在众多小孩子的眼神当中，开始忙碌了起来。
content_en:
A few days later, the Huo family was completely sure that Huo Hai had indeed lost part of his memory, and a large part of it.Fortunately, he still remembers the other people in his family.Just forget it, it doesn't matter, Huo Hai is not old anyway.

As the eldest and only young master of the Huo family, let alone losing his memory, even if he is crazy, he will still be the future leader of the Huo family.On this day, Huo Kai came to Huo Hai and said with a serious face: "Xiao Hai, we can't do anything about your amnesia, but you have to know some common sense, so we decided to send you to study."

Study?What's going on? Huo Hai's head is full of question marks.He knew that at this time, it was best not to ask too many questions.

"Very good. Since you don't object, that's it. From today on, you will go to school with other family members to learn some basics and common sense. Others can wait until later."

After saying that, Huo Kai left.Huo Hai shook his head helplessly: "Hey, I don't even know what this world is like, but I was asked to go to school. Oh my god, I finally graduated, why do I have to go to school in a different world? Can't I practice more spiritual skills?" Huo Hai likes training more than blood.

If I didn't practice before, I would have thought that a person sitting here dull and motionless would look like an idiot. One must have strong perseverance to persevere.But after practicing, Huo Hai didn't think so anymore.

Absorbing spiritual energy into the body and constantly tempering oneself, one can feel that oneself is getting stronger and the body is sublimating all the time.And this wonderful feeling makes people want to stop, it is simply more comfortable than doing that kind of thing.

Now, Huo Hai finally understood why some masters could sit there and practice for several years or even decades without moving. It turned out that practicing was such a comfortable thing.Not only can it make you comfortable, but it can also make you stronger.Once you have strength, you have status, you have everything. If you have the opportunity to practice, who would let it go?

But my father decided that this was the only way to go."Forget it, let's see what is learned in that class. Maybe we can deepen our understanding of the entire world." Huo Hai shook his head and started practicing again.

I don't know how long it will take to enter the realm of spiritual blood. It seems like time will be wasted.It took several years to cultivate to the spirit body. Now it will take several months to cultivate to the spiritual blood, no matter how diligent you are.

Time passed during Huo Hai's night of practice.Early the next morning, the maid woke Huo Hai up."Master, Master, wake up quickly, you have to go to the school later." Speaking of the school, the two maids looked a little strange.

"Yes, I still have to go to school." Huo Hai said to himself, having gone to bed very late last night.However, due to his cultivation, Huo Hai was in good spirits, and he did not see the expressions of the two maids.Under the service of the maid, Huo Hai got dressed, had dinner, and then walked towards the school with the boy.Why is there a book boy? Because he also carries many books.

"The young master's life is really good. This kind of life was something that not many people on Earth could enjoy before. I wonder what I will learn later, and whether it will have anything to do with practicing spiritual techniques."

In Huo Hai's mind, he suddenly recalled that he had seen a lot of novels and animations about magic schools and the like. It would be great if this was the case.Huo Hai, who had incomplete memory and had just started practicing, had many questions that he didn't understand and was eager to figure them out.

A few minutes later, Huo Hai came outside the school under the leadership of the book boy.Speaking of which, this school is still the Huo family's own school, and the people targeted are also the direct descendants and concubines of the Huo family, and even the children of some side relatives.The children of servants can only be book boys, and they are not qualified to enter the school.

After Huo Hai came here, he found that there were already many book boys here.They all gathered at the door or lying on the windowsill, waiting for the instructor's lecture.As servants, they are only qualified to listen in this way.

Seeing this situation, Huo Hai couldn't help but feel a trace of compassion in his heart."Hey, it's really pitiful. If it were Earth, no matter how poor you were, you could at least have an elementary school to study in." In the spiritual continent, there are only a few people who are qualified to enjoy education.

Suddenly, Huo Hai shook his head fiercely: "How could I have such an idea? Don't I want to be a bad person? What should a bad person do when he sees this situation and be indifferent? No, that's not the case. By the way, he should step forward and sarcastically use pressure." Huo Hai thought about it for a long time and finally remembered what a bad person should do.

But just when Huo Hai was about to take action, he saw the longing and admiring eyes of these book boys, and the words he originally planned to say were swallowed back in his stomach.After all, Huo Hai is not a person with a corrupt nature and cannot take action.

"Forget it, I'll let you go today, and I'll come back another day." Huo Hai muttered, giving up on the so-called bad guys' ways, and entered the school.As soon as Huo Hai entered, the students inside immediately focused on Huo Hai, and Huo Hai felt his scalp numb.Then, instead of feeling numb, his face looked depressed and shocked.

"Who, who can tell me what is going on? Do I have to study with these children?" Huo Hai finally knew why his father's eyes looked so weird that day and what common sense he was learning.

Damn, this is not learning common sense. Is this simply preschool enlightenment?Looking at these little eyes, their owners are only three years old and no more than six years old.This body of mine is at least fourteen or fifteen years old. In this world, it is considered an adult.Isn't it possible to study with these children who have not grown up yet?

"Hey, is that the new guy? Isn't he the young master of the Zong family? Why is he here?" The child couldn't stop talking.Maybe adults wouldn't talk about it casually, but how could a child have such an idea?

"Yes, yes, I heard about it too. It seems that Master Huo Hai was injured and lost his memory for some reason. Even the things we need to learn have to be learned again." Next to him, a cute little girl said with a proud face.

Hey, let me talk about you, you look cute, but your mouth is so hateful, what does it mean to be injured and have amnesia, and what you have learned must be relearned.Are you showing off your superiority in front of me?Huo Hai almost cursed in his heart.He felt like he couldn't stay here any longer.

But soon, he saw something even more abominable.A cute little boy looked at Huo Hai with sympathy in his eyes."Ah, it turns out that the eldest young master is so pitiful. He has wasted so many years."

"Yes, yes, it's so pitiful." This sentence immediately resonated with the children.Children are probably the most compassionate creatures in the world.All eyes turned to pity and sympathy.

Huo Hai felt like he was going crazy: "Asshole, I don't need your pity. No, no, I don't need your pity at all. No, this is not right either." Huo Hai was completely confused.These children cannot be beaten or scolded.Although I am motivated to be a bad guy, bad guys also have a bottom line. How can a child bully you casually?

Thinking of this, Huo Hai suddenly felt like he couldn't stay any longer.So he turned around and walked outside.But as soon as he reached the door, he was stopped by two guards.These two people blocked the door and refused to let Huo Hai go out.

"Master, I have ordered that you cannot leave this place before the lecture is over. Don't make it difficult for us. In order for you to get your lost memories back as soon as possible, master, please feel aggrieved." The two guards said pitifully, but they had no intention of getting out of the way.The cultivation level of these two guards is higher than Huo Hai.

"You really don't want to get out of the way." Huo Hai's expression changed. He bumped into him several times but couldn't get out.

The two guards looked at each other, and their expressions became even more bitter. These two were the two people who went out to capture the spirit beasts with Huo Hai before, and now they were sent to look at Huo Hai: "Master, please don't embarrass us two. If you go out today, I will break our legs." Master Huo Hai is easy to talk to, and they would not dare to say this to anyone else.

"You guys, you really won't get out of the way... Okay, then I'll get out of the way." Huo Hai, who was sure that he couldn't get out, was immediately discouraged and returned to the school.At this time, the instructor has not yet come to the school.

Some of the children in the school were talking together, and some were looking at books made of special leaves in their hands, reviewing what they learned yesterday.Huo Hai was in no mood to hang out with these children.In my previous life, I was already in my twenties.This body in this life also looks like a fourteen or fifteen year old, plus a certain amount of memory.

Calculating it, I am afraid that my inner age is already over 30 years old. How can I lower my face and be with these little guys? With no place to vent, Huo Hai began to scan the surroundings.

Suddenly, an idea flashed in Huo Hai's eyes: "By the way, I want to start doing bad things from a young age, so let's try my hand first. Anyway, there should be no such methods in this world." In Huo Hai's head, scenes of a large number of students playing pranks on their teachers suddenly came back to mind.Many of these images were taken from television.I also learned it from computer books.

Thanks to television and those bad people for giving us so many ways to trick teachers.If I don't reappear in this world, wouldn't I be ashamed of my status as a time traveler?Huo Hai felt that his whole body was about to burn.

He did whatever he thought of, and Huo Hai started to get busy in the eyes of many children.
